Malo-awaal: shibbane hore kasta, shaqal, iyo dambe si xor ah ayaa loo lammaaneyn karaa, waxaana tirinaynaa qaababka la samayn karo. Ma tixgelinayno haddii higaaddadaas runtii la isticmaalo.

y-m-81-05.s.s1.explain: Higaaddada aan dambe lahayn waxay tiradoodu tahay 19×21=399, wadarta guud-na waa 19×21×28=11172. Saamigu waa 399÷11172=1/28≈3.6%. y-m-81-06.title: Haddii hal geesood shaqeeyo, ma qaabka oo dhan ayaa shaqeeya?
y-m-81-06.topic: Qaababka afar-geesoodka joogtada ah iyo daboolidda cabbirka
y-m-81-06.goal: Hel dhowr isku-darka oo xaglahoodu geesood hal ku isugu daraan 360°, oo go'aami in shuruudani aysan ku filnayn buuxinta cabbirka oo dhan.
y-m-81-06.material: Marka qaab la samaynayo, waxaad ku xirtaa taayirro afar-geesood joogto ah adigoon u dhexayn bannaan iyo is-dhaafsi. Xaglaha taayirrada ku kulma hal geesood waa inay isugu darmaan 360°. Cabbirka hal xagal ee n-geesood joogto ah waxaa go'aamiya n (saddex-geesood joogto ah 60°, afar-geesood joogto ah 90°, lix-geesood joogto ah 120°). Hawshan waxaan eegnaa xaalada saddex afar-geesood joogto ah ay ku kulmaan hal geesood oo keliya, tirada dhinacyaduna waa tiro dabiici ah oo ka bilaabma 3 ilaa 50.
y-m-81-06.thinking.1: Helidda isku-darka kala duwan ee buuxiya xaddidaadaha
y-m-81-06.thinking.2: Kala saarista shuruudaha loo baahan yahay iyo shuruudaha ku filan
y-m-81-06.prereq.1: Cabbirka xagasha gudaha ee afar-geesood joogto ah (joomatari dugsiga dhexe), xallinta jajabyada iyo isla'egyada
y-m-81-06.prereq.2: Dareen ku saabsan afar-geesoodyada joogtada ah ee ku wareegsan hal dhibic (xaglo isugu darma wareeg buuxa)
y-m-81-06.s.s1.prompt: Marka hore qiyaas. Marka laga reebo saddex lix-geesood joogto ah (6,6,6), isku-darka kale ee saddex afar-geesood joogto ah hal geesood ee xaglahoodu ku darmaan 360° waa maxay? (n-geesood wuxuu leeyahay n dhinac, n-na waa ugu badnaan 50.)
y-m-81-06.s.s1.hint.0: Haddii uu jiro hal saddex-geesood joogto ah (60°), ka fikir wadarta xaglaha labada afar-geesood ee kale waa inay noqotaa.
y-m-81-06.s.s1.hint.1: Isticmaal isla habka marka uu jiro hal afar-geesood joogto ah (90°), oo hel dhowr isku-dar.
y-m-81-06.s.s1.o.a: Mid kale oo aan ahayn (6,6,6) ma jiro.
y-m-81-06.s.s1.r.a: Afar-geesoodyada joogtada ah ee aan ahayn saddex-geesood, afar-geesood, iyo lix-geesood (sida siddeed-geesood joogto ah) sidoo kale waxay leeyihiin xaglo. Maxaa dhici lahaa haddii aad tijaabiso hal ama laba ka mid ah?
y-m-81-06.s.s1.o.b: Waxaa jira dhowr isku-dar oo keliya oo ay ku jirto saddex-geesood joogto ah.
y-m-81-06.s.s1.r.b: Sidoo kale hubi haddii ay jiraan isku-dar aan lahayn saddex-geesood joogto ah. Maxay yihiin wadarrada ay ku jirto shan-geesood joogto ah ama siddeed-geesood joogto ah?
y-m-81-06.s.s1.o.c: Marka laga reebo (6,6,6), waxaa jira dhowr kale.
y-m-81-06.s.s1.r.c: Waxaad furan ka dhigtay in afar-geesoodyo aan ahayn saddex-geesood, afar-geesood, iyo lix-geesood la isticmaali karo. Waad si toos ah u tijaabin kartaa si aad u hubiso tirada.
y-m-81-06.s.s1.o.d: Waxaa jira si sax ah hal kale.
y-m-81-06.s.s1.r.d: Way adag tahay in la helo sabab ah in hal kale oo keliya jiro. Si toos ah u tiri imisa isku-dar ayaad samayn kartaa adoo isticmaalaya afar-geesoodyo aan ahayn saddex-geesood, afar-geesood, iyo lix-geesood.
y-m-81-06.s.s1.explain: Haddii aad adigu ku raadiso tallaabada xigta, waxaad heli doontaa in ay jiraan 10 isku-dar oo wada ah, oo ay ku jirto (6,6,6).
y-m-81-06.s.s2.prompt: Hel oo geli 4 isku-dar oo kala duwan oo a-geesood joogto ah, b-geesood joogto ah, iyo c-geesood joogto ah ay ku kulmaan hal geesood xaglahoodunna ay isugu darmaan si sax ah 360°. (3 ≤ a ≤ b ≤ c ≤ 50, dhammaantood waa tirooyin dabiici ah. Isku-dar kala horreyn kale leh u tiri isku mid.)

y-m-81-06.s.s3.prompt: Eeg (5,5,10) isku-darka aad heshay dhexdiisa. Hal geesood, laba shan-geesood joogto ah iyo hal toban-geesood joogto ah waxay buuxin karaan 360°. Markaas ma isku-darkan oo keliya ayaa samayn kara qaab buuxiya cabbirka oo dhan iyadoo aan bannaan lahayn?
y-m-81-06.s.s3.hint.0: Sawir geesaha qaababka ku xiga hareeraha hal dhinac ee toban-geesoodka joogtada ah oo hubi haddii isla isku-darka uu sii socdo.

y-m-81-06.s.s3.o.a: Hal dhibic oo is waafaqda ma ku filna in la ogaado. Waa inaad si gooni ah u hubisaa in geesaha ku xiga sidoo kale is waafaqaan.
y-m-81-06.s.s3.r.a: Waxaad kala saartay is waafaqidda hal dhibic iyo is waafaqidda meel walba. Waxaad kala saartay waxa shuruud loo baahan yahay iyo waxa shuruud ku filan.
y-m-81-06.s.s3.o.b: Kaliya (4,6,12), isku-darka isticmaala saddexda nooc oo dhan, ayaa buuxin kara cabbirka oo dhan iyadoo aan bannaan lahayn.
y-m-81-06.s.s3.r.b: (6,6,6) iyo (4,8,8) sidoo kale waxay leeyihiin qaabab buuxiya cabbirka oo dhan. Tirada noocyadu ma aha halbeegga.
y-m-81-06.s.s3.o.c: Xaglaha hal geesood si sax ah ayay isugu darmaan, sidaas darteed sii wadista si la mid ah had iyo jeer waxay buuxin doontaa cabbirka oo dhan.
y-m-81-06.s.s3.r.c: Xaglaha hal dhibic oo si sax ah isugu darma waa shuruud loo baahan yahay. Haddii geesaha ku xiga sidoo kale ku shaqeeyaan isla isku-darka waa arrin gooni ah.
y-m-81-06.s.s3.o.d: Tirada isku-darka ee ka shaqeeya hal geesood had iyo jeer waxay le'eg tahay tirada qaababka buuxiya cabbirka.
y-m-81-06.s.s3.r.d: Su'aashu waa haddii isku-dar kasta uu buuxiyo cabbirka oo dhan. Ma jirto sabab tirada isku-darka iyo tirada qaababku u le'eg yihiin.
y-m-81-06.s.s3.explain: Xaglaha hal geesood oo isugu darma 360° waa shuruud loo baahan yahay, ma aha mid ku filan. Sida la ogyahay, 10-ka kore dhexdooda, kaliya (3,12,12), (4,6,12), (4,8,8), iyo (6,6,6) ayaa buuxiya cabbirka oo dhan iyadoo hal nooc habayn geesood la isticmaalayo, (5,5,10) na ma buuxin karo cabbirka oo dhan sababtoo ah sii wadista geesaha ku xiga waxay keentaa is-diid.
